$schema_note: Example 1Password vault-hygiene manifest. Metadata only -- NO secret values live here. This file demonstrates the class1_move / class1_already_automation / class2_anchors_never_move shape that check-vault-boundary.js and move-to-automation.js expect. Replace every entry with your own vault's real item titles before use.
purpose: Scope your automation identity to ONLY the `Automation` 1Password vault. Class-1 automation credentials belong in Automation (safe for a scoped bot). Class-2 trust anchors must stay operator-only and NEVER enter Automation (a bot that can read them could forge its own authorization).
OPERATOR_MUST_VERIFY: Entries below are illustrative placeholders. Replace them with entries DERIVED FROM `op://` REFERENCES FOUND IN YOUR OWN CODEBASE, then VERIFY every title/vault against your live 1Password BEFORE running `move-to-automation.js --apply`. Item titles are the join key for `op item move`; a wrong title is a silent no-op or a wrong move.

class1_move.title: example-third-party-api-key
class1_move.duplicate_note: A distinct item `Example Third Party API` ALREADY EXISTS in Automation (op://Automation/Example Third Party API/credential). DO NOT blind-move this duplicate. Operator must decide whether to consolidate or keep separate items.

class1_move.title: example-bootstrap-passphrase
class1_move.classification_note: This is a bootstrap/kernel passphrase example. It may be a TRUST ANCHOR (class-2), not an ordinary automation credential -- if the bot can read it, it can decrypt/forge bootstrap material. DO NOT MOVE until the operator explicitly classifies it. The mover SKIPS this entry and reports it as needs-operator-decision.

class2_anchors_never_move.title: example-governance-unlock
class2_anchors_never_move.reason: Governance unlock / approval-mint anchor. If the automation identity could read this, it could self-issue governance approvals. MUST stay operator-only and MUST NOT be in Automation.

class2_anchors_never_move.title: example-approval-signing-key
class2_anchors_never_move.reason: Approval HMAC signing key. If the automation identity could read this, it could forge approvals. MUST stay operator-only and MUST NOT be in Automation.
